entities.name: Kanagawa Prefectural Museum of Natural History
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Kanagawa Prefectural Museum of Natural History  is a natural history museum in the city of Odawara in Kanagawa Prefecture, Japan. The museum has an extensive geology section, and focuses on the flora and fauna of Kanagawa prefecture.
